originality.rationale: The exact all-case enumerator and multiplicative channel transfer were not stated in the initiating paper, were not implied by the closest published-finding corpus records, and were not found under targeted Tait-colouring, perfect-matching-cover, truncation, or channel aliases. Standard triangle and 2-cycle reductions cover existence phenomena, but the exact factor across mixed diamond/2-cycle strings and its assembly into a complete three-cover count require the additional local multiplicity argument. Residual risk from older differently phrased edge-colouring literature is retained.
residual_risks: Older edge-colouring or Tait-colouring literature may contain the same \(2^q\) multiplicity transfer under expansion/reduction terminology not surfaced by the searches.
The Petersen cutoff is restricted to simple cores; nonsimple-core minimality is deliberately not claimed.

value.rationale: The result gives the exact size of the minimal perfect-matching-cover layer for the entire structural class of bridgeless claw-free cubic graphs, not merely another existence example. It directly complements a 2026 paper whose main questions concern four- and five-perfect-matching covers, and the formula separates core complexity from a simple multiplicative contribution of every channel gadget. The sharp 30-vertex simple-core boundary identifies the first obstruction in a natural subclass.
